name: Biological Sciences (BS)
scope: 2026–27 CALS biological sciences foundation and 14 concentration options. Adviser-dependent overlap, petitions and college rules are explicit checks.

manual.label: Lab research approval
manual.instruction: Where research supplies laboratory credit, have the advisor confirm the recognized laboratory component.

manual.label: Category overlap
manual.instruction: Verify any proposed course serving multiple ecology core or field categories with the advisor.

checks.label: Advisor-approved biology laboratory or field course

manual.label: Three distinct concentrations
manual.instruction: Verify three listed courses from distinct concentrations and any permitted overlap. Research credit cannot represent a concentration.

manual.label: Petitioned credit limit
manual.instruction: Confirm the maximum of three petitioned credits when using courses outside the published list.

slots.label: Marine electives from Groups A and B

manual.label: Field and introductory overlap
manual.instruction: Confirm the field requirement. If an introductory course also meets a foundation requirement, the advisor must confirm the introductory slot and exclude its credits from the concentration total.

checks.label: At least two advanced listed courses of two or more credits

slots.label: Neurobiology and behavior I with discussion
Neurobiology and behavior II with discussion

manual.label: Research and alternative discussion credit
manual.instruction: Confirm the combined research limit and any separately arranged discussion component.

choices.label: Select two distinct introductory biology areas

options.label: General Chemistry I and II with laboratories
First organic chemistry course and experimental laboratory

manual.label: CALS degree and cohort requirements
manual.instruction: Confirm the 120-credit CALS degree, residence, graded credits, and the distribution rules for your entering cohort and transfer status.

manual.label: Foundation credit total and college equivalencies
manual.instruction: Confirm the applicable credit total and discuss any accepted substitutions with the Office of Undergraduate Biology.

manual.label: Transfer credit and petition review
manual.instruction: Confirm approved transfer equivalencies with the Office of Undergraduate Biology.
